summary.headline: Seismological Omens by Zodiac Sign
summary.text: Interpretation of the seismologion through the zodiac signs, giving omens for thunder and earthquakes in April through July. Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, and Leo predict harvests, famine, disease, warfare, animal deaths, weather, crop yields, social disorder, and religious or enemy threats.
